result.instructions: Tools for Release Radar, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What broke since our last deploy of the acme-corp/web-app repo?"; "Give me an incident snapshot of what is on fire right now."; "Prepare a start-of-shift handoff for on-call, using the acme-corp/web-app repo.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Release Radar data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run release_radar_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run release_radar_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run release_radar_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. release_radar_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: release_radar_whats_broken_since_last_deploy
tools.title: What's broken since the last deploy?
tools.description: COMPOSITE. Finds the latest GitHub deployment/release for a repo, then queries Sentry for unresolved issues SINCE that deploy's timestamp (the deploy time drives the Sentry window), then looks up who's currently on-call in PagerDuty — and synthesizes one situational-awareness object. Degrades gracefully: if Sentry or PagerDuty creds are absent it returns what it can plus a note. GitHub is required (it's the anchor).

sentry_project.description: Sentry project slug/id. Falls back to SENTRY_PROJECT env if omitted.

environment.description: Filter GitHub deployments and Sentry issues to this environment, e.g. 'production'.

tools.name: release_radar_incident_snapshot
tools.title: Current incident snapshot
tools.description: COMPOSITE. A right-now on-call picture: top unresolved Sentry issues + active (triggered/acknowledged) PagerDuty incidents + who's currently on-call, fused into one snapshot with a human summary. Each service degrades independently if its creds are missing.

sentry_project.description: Sentry project slug/id. Falls back to SENTRY_PROJECT env if omitted.

tools.name: release_radar_oncall_handoff
tools.title: On-call handoff briefing
tools.description: COMPOSITE. A start-of-shift briefing for whoever is currently on call, fusing all three services: (a) PagerDuty current on-call + any active (triggered/acknowledged) incidents they're inheriting, (b) the GitHub deployment/release that most recently shipped (what's live), and (c) Sentry's top unresolved errors. Correlates them into one object — including a heads-up when a fresh deploy coincides with active incidents (a likely culprit). Degrades gracefully: every service is optional; whatever's unconfigured or failing is named in `notes` and the briefing still returns. Never crashes.

sentry_project.description: Sentry project slug/id. Falls back to SENTRY_PROJECT env if omitted.

tools.name: release_radar_github_latest_deploy
tools.title: Latest GitHub deploy/release
tools.description: Low-level building block: the latest GitHub deployment for a repo (falls back to the latest release), returning sha + timestamp. Used internally by release_radar_whats_broken_since_last_deploy. GitHub: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/deployments.

tools.name: release_radar_sentry_recent_issues
tools.title: Recent unresolved Sentry issues
tools.description: Low-level building block: unresolved Sentry issues over a relative window. Sentry: GET /api/0/projects/{org}/{project}/issues/?query=is:unresolved.

sentry_project.description: Sentry project slug/id (falls back to SENTRY_PROJECT env).

prompts.description: The AI finds the latest GitHub deployment or release of a repo, lists the unresolved Sentry issues since that time, and names who is on call in PagerDuty.

prompts.title: Get a snapshot of what is on fire now
prompts.description: The AI combines the top unresolved Sentry issues, the triggered and acknowledged PagerDuty incidents and the current on-call person into one short summary.

prompts.title: Prepare an on-call handoff briefing
prompts.description: The AI shows who is on call, the active incidents they inherit, what is live from the latest GitHub deploy and the top Sentry errors. It warns when a fresh deploy and active incidents come at the same time.
